text:
The ionic equations for some reactions between metals and aqueous metal ions are shown.
Cu  +  2Ag+→  2Ag  +  Cu2+
Mg  +  Zn2+→  Mg2+  +  Zn
Zn  +  Cu2+→  Cu  +  Zn2+
Sn  +  Cu2+→  Sn2+  +  Cu
Which further information can be used to place copper, magnesium, silver, tin and zinc in order of
their reactivity?
Zinc reacts with Sn2+ ions.
A
Copper does not react with Sn2+ ions.
B
Magnesium reacts with Cu2+ ions.
C
Magnesium reacts with Ag+ ions.
D

options.label: B
options.text: Copper does not react with Sn2+ ions.
